notes:
Fixed

  • Roll configuration dialog now shows for players. When the GM sent a check/save/skill request from the in-module roll request menu, the player's dnd5e roll dialog (advantage / situational bonus) was being skipped. The module was using the legacy dnd5e roll signature, whose compatibility path fast-forwarded the dialog. It now uses the modern dnd5e 5.x roll API and forces the dialog to appear, with the GM's requested advantage/disadvantage pre-selected.
